termsStatement: Prodávající není plátcem daně z přidané hodnoty. Fakturu vystaví prodávající kupujícímu po uhrazení ceny zboží
interpretationLimit: That ARES source-state flag alone is insufficient to independently establish current VAT-payer status. Do not present it as a verified contradiction or silently infer tax treatment. Earlier commentary calling it active VAT registration was stronger than the recorded evidence.
requiredDataTreatment: Retain official final displayed retail prices, explicitly record merchant non-payer statement and tax-status review. Do not invent an included VAT rate/amount or purchase guarantee.
